description: This PHP class 'SaveEmployeeReportController' is a server-side controller within the OrangeHRM application. It extends an abstract Vue controller and prepares data components for saving or editing employee report configurations, including report criteria, display field groups, and display fields. It leverages traits for internationalization and report generation services.

classes.name: SaveEmployeeReportController
classes.description: A controller that manages the preparation of components for saving or editing employee reports in the OrangeHRM application. It dynamically assembles Vue components with properties for report criteria and display fields based on request parameters and service data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets a Vue component with report criteria, display field groups, and display fields to be used in the frontend for creating or editing employee reports, based on the provided HTTP request.
